title: Metal-free Minisci C–H alkylation of hydrazones using aldehydes: an unexpected route to hydrazone-containing pyrimidine derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22261-22268
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01465H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Atefeh Tirehdast, Volodymyr Semeniuchenko, Ali Shiri
A practical method for metal-free, Minisci-type decarbonylative functionalization of pyrimidines using aldehydes has been developed, yielding hydrazone derivatives.
